title: Sentence Pyramid Worksheets — 113 Pages Phonics Fluency Practice (AUS-UK Version)

overview.description: 126-page (113 content pages) phonics fluency resource. Students read sentence pyramids — each line adds a word, building from 1 word to full sentences. They highlight target phonics skill words, then color the matching picture. Comprehensive scope: CVC → short vowels → consonant blends → digraphs → Magic E → R-controlled vowels → vowel teams → diphthongs → ending blends. AUS-UK spelling version. Includes table of contents with scope showing exact page ranges for each skill.

gaps.name: sentence-pyramid
gaps.description: Progressive sentence building — each line adds a word. Line 1: 'The'. Line 2: 'The dog'. Line 3: 'The dog ran'. Student reads each level, highlights target phonics skill, colors matching picture. Great for fluency building with phonics focus.

pyramidScaffolding.description: Each page builds a sentence one word at a time, creating a pyramid shape. This scaffolds reading fluency — the student succeeds at each level before adding complexity.
pyramidScaffolding.value: Built-in differentiation and confidence building. Struggling readers can stop at shorter lines; advanced readers complete the full pyramid.

notes: Comprehensive phonics scope from CVC through diphthongs. The pyramid format is clever for fluency — unlike isolated word lists, it builds towards real sentences. AUS-UK spelling version suggests Aless is sourcing internationally.
